name: Bleeding disorder due to CalDAG-GEFI deficiency

criteria.description: Recurrent mucocutaneous bleeding episodes including epistaxis and easy bruising
Impaired platelet aggregation response to ADP and other agonists on platelet function assays
Identification of biallelic pathogenic variants in RASGRP2 gene encoding CalDAG-GEFI
Normal platelet count with isolated functional defect
Consanguinity or family history of similar bleeding phenotype

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of recurrent mucocutaneous bleeding, impaired platelet aggregation on functional testing, and confirmation of biallelic RASGRP2 pathogenic variants
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires exclusion of other platelet function disorders and coagulation factor deficiencies.

pathognomonic.notes: Includes frequent epistaxis and gingival bleeding
searchTerms: severe bleeding from skin and mucous membranes
heavy bleeding in mouth and skin

pathognomonic.symptomName: Prolonged bleeding time despite normal platelet count
searchTerms: bleeding lasts long even with normal platelets
prolonged bleeding time despite normal platelet levels
extended bleeding despite normal platelet count
bleeding after surgery or dental work

common.symptomName: Petechiae on skin and mucous membranes
searchTerms: tiny red spots on skin and mucous membranes
small hemorrhages on skin and mucosa
minor cuts bleed for a long time
prolonged bleeding from minor skin injuries

laboratory: Impaired platelet aggregation to ADP, collagen, and thrombin receptor agonists
imaging: Imaging may reveal hemorrhagic complications such as intracranial bleeding in severe cases
other: Family history consistent with autosomal recessive inheritance
Platelet flow cytometry showing defective integrin αIIbβ3 activation

distinguishingFeatures: Absent or severely reduced platelet aggregation to all agonists
Mutations in ITGA2B or ITGB3 genes
Mucosal bleeding secondary to skin involvement
Defect in platelet adhesion due to GPIb-IX-V complex deficiency
Prolonged bleeding time with abnormal ristocetin-induced platelet aggregation

redFlags: Severe mucocutaneous bleeding unresponsive to standard hemostatic measures
Intracranial hemorrhage or other life-threatening bleeding episodes
Family history of early-onset bleeding disorder
references: Canault M, et al. RASGRP2 mutations associated with platelet dysfunction. Blood. 2014.
Nurden AT, et al. CalDAG-GEFI deficiency: a novel platelet signaling disorder. Haematologica. 2015.
Orphanet: Bleeding disorder due to CalDAG-GEFI deficiency (ORPHA:420566)
